title: What Happens If You Drink 2 Cups of Green Tea Every Day?

scenes.text: What happens when you sip 2 cups of green tea each day?
It adds about 30–50 mg of caffeine, giving a gentle alertness without jitters.
scenes.label: CAFFEINE BOOST

scenes.text: Rich in L‑theanine, it promotes relaxation while maintaining focus, balancing stress hormones.
scenes.label: L‑THEANINE RELAX

scenes.text: The antioxidants, especially EGCG, support heart health and may improve metabolism.
scenes.label: EGCG ANTIOXIDANTS

scenes.text: Follow for your daily dose of vitality.

description: Discover how just two cups of green tea a day can boost alertness, calm stress, and support your heart. Simple, science‑backed benefits you can start today. Follow for more quick health hacks!
